participant_id.Description: Participant identifier from the events filenames.

rt_ses1_MJ.Description: Mean retained MJ reaction time in session 1.

acc_ses1_MJ.Description: Proportion correct on retained MJ trials in session 1.

rt_ses2_MJ.Description: Mean retained MJ reaction time in session 2.

acc_ses2_MJ.Description: Proportion correct on retained MJ trials in session 2.

RTFiltering: Positive finite task-trial RTs; minimum 0.200 seconds; maximum mean + 3 SD after combining runs within each participant, session, and task. The same RT cutoffs are applied to accuracy trials.
AccuracyCoding: Accuracy code 1 means correct; code 2 means incorrect.
MissingValues: Missing measures are represented as n/a in the TSV.
